name: What functional adjustments can improve my home's energy efficiency?

mainEntity.name: What functional adjustments can improve my home's energy efficiency?

acceptedAnswer.text: Functional adjustments that can improve energy efficiency include sealing gaps around windows and doors, ensuring proper closure of exterior doors, and adjusting attic access panels for a tighter seal. Checking and adjusting weather stripping can also prevent drafts. These adjustments help maintain consistent indoor temperatures, reducing the workload on your heating and cooling systems.
acceptedAnswer.description: Sealing gaps around windows/doors and adjusting weather stripping can improve energy efficiency.
